description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 14.11.2016 to 20.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters related to customs operations. It exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to establish new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges, and formally rescinds previous exchange rate notifications. The content focuses on regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
